editorial:
Imagine living in a cozy lighthouse with your best friend, but that friend has a wild habit of flying around while fast asleep. That is exactly what you get with this sweet little short. You have a small, stressed-out snipe who spends all his time trying to stop his big pelican buddy from crashing into walls or floating away in the middle of the night. It feels like a classic cartoon from the golden age, with a lighthearted vibe that makes you root for the little guy. The friendship between the two birds is the heart of the story, and the silly situations they get into keep you smiling throughout the whole thing.

What really works here is the physical comedy and the way the animation captures the panic of the snipe. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though it is a very short experience. If you love old-school Disney style animation, you should definitely check this out. It is a perfect choice for a family movie night when you only have a few minutes to spare.
endingExplained: The story wraps up after a series of chaotic mishaps where the snipe tries every trick in the book to keep the pelican grounded. In the final scenes, the pelican finally wakes up and realizes how much his friend has been worrying. They share a warm moment of friendship, showing that no matter how annoying the sleep-flying is, they will always look out for each other. It ends on a happy, cozy note in their lighthouse home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cartoons and cute animal friendships.
